messages.author: e65db9bcd971d511
messages.subject: diagonal argument in INLA control
parts:
Hi INLA Members,

I see that in control.inla we have an option called diagonal and it makes computation faster. Can you please tell what do you mean by joint precision matrix in inla?

y~f(ID1,x,model="besag")+ f(ID2,xx,model="besag")...


diagonal

Numerical Expert use only! Add a this value on the diagonal of the joint precision matrix. (default 0.0)



Alokesh

messages.subject: Re: diagonal argument in INLA control

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Re: diagonal argument in INLA control
parts:
I'm not sure where you got the impression that it "speeds up" the inference. If things finish faster with that option, it will only be because the modified model is easier than the original, intended, model. In some cases, it can be used _very carefully_ to solve the original model, E.g. in a sequence of runs with gradually decreasing "diagonal" value. It does change the inference, so should not be used without proper consideration. 

As the documentation says, this is an Expert option only, and it shouldn't be used if you don't understand the implications. 

Finn
